id_distribution.allocation_caveat: For reporting, allocate a root weight to its sides proportional to inverse multiplicities. Actual training weights the single joint-root loss; this is not a separate side-head gradient allocation.

field_semantics.multiplicity: Count of admitted mature TRAIN (root,positive side) memberships for the same immutable first-qualifying physical crossing ID; pooled across classes and sides. The same physical crossing can qualify LONG from one earlier entry and SHORT from another; its shared count intentionally includes both.
field_semantics.origin_span_s: Last minus first admitted TRAIN origin for that ID. It is the observed preimage span, not a trade holding time, full physical opportunity duration, or count*5 seconds.
field_semantics.count_times_cadence_s: Multiplicity * 5s is grid exposure proxy. Even a contiguous group has span=(count-1)*5s; missing/interleaved memberships may make span larger.
field_semantics.admitted_membership_density: Count / (span/5s + 1): occupancy of the regular-grid envelope between first/last admitted memberships; not a probability of opportunity.
field_semantics.delay_s: First qualifying crossing timestamp minus entry timestamp for this root/side; different roots sharing the same crossing ID generally have different delays.
field_semantics.gain_margin: Maximum net mark across observed first crossings of all nine BB lines within 300s, minus fixed G_event. It is NOT the margin at the first qualifying crossing, full-path MFE, or executed profit.
field_semantics.gain_margin_R: gain_margin / R_event. Includes the target reference fee .30 and entry BBO spread through the net mark.
field_semantics.G_over_R: G_event/R_event is fixed by design at 2, independently of the execution stop-risk plan.
field_semantics.both: BOTH root metrics average the two positive side memberships unless named minimum/maximum/effective. Effective multiplicity is harmonic mean(mL,mS), because raw weight is mean(1/mL,1/mS).
field_semantics.quantiles: Boundaries are class-specific weight quantiles. Equal weights are kept together, so bin sizes and >=q90 tail proportions may differ from nominal fractions. Stats use weighted empirical step quantiles.

interpretation.formula: NONE=1; L/S inverse ID multiplicity; BOTH average inverses; normalize each joint class to preserve its original total mass. The weight multiplies the entire root BCE plus conditional direction CE.
interpretation.estimand_change: Within each positive class the optimization measure changes from uniform decision origins toward lower-multiplicity witness IDs. It does not simply delete identical examples or guarantee independent/equal event weights.
interpretation.observational_only: Relations between weight, observed origin span, delay and margin are descriptive TRAIN associations. No causal explanation, score advantage, profitability, or model-quality conclusion follows.
interpretation.short_and_rare: Use low-multiplicity or short observed admitted-preimage span. This audit cannot identify physically rare regimes or prove short trade duration from group count alone.
